Definition: chastisement; figuratively (by words) correction, refutation, proof (even in defence)
BiblicalUsage: 1) rebuke, correction, reproof, punishment, chastisement; 2) argument, reproof; 2a) argument, impeachment; 2b) reproof, chiding; 2c) correction, rebuke
